description: Proposal success criteria (docs/REMEDIATION_PLAN.md Phase 4). Each id maps to eval/results/<id>.json written by the listed script. Targets live here only; scripts and the Evaluation page both read this file.

criteria.title: Person detection
criteria.dataset: CAVIAR shopping-centre GT (frozen frame sample); own-store CVAT set when labelled

criteria.title: Multi-object tracking
criteria.criterion: Tracking quality: IDF1 / MOTA / HOTA / ID switches (not in the proposal; examiners will ask)

criteria.title: Re-ID in the store domain
criteria.criterion: Same-person vs different-person separation on held-out CAVIAR store sequences (not in the proposal; supports the REID_T_MATCH choice)
criteria.dataset: CAVIAR hold-out sequences, GT person crops

criteria.title: Fire and smoke
criteria.dataset: D-Fire test split (frozen subset) + negative store video

criteria.title: Age band and gender
criteria.criterion: Demographics: report gender accuracy, age-band accuracy (exact and +/-1 band), per-group gaps and CPU latency per face (not in the proposal)

criteria.title: Video synopsis
criteria.criterion: Synopsis >= 10x compression with 100% of events kept

criteria.title: Real-time throughput
criteria.dataset: 4 recorded 720p clips played as live cameras

criteria.title: Adversarial robustness
criteria.criterion: Report detector robustness under FGSM/PGD (Adversarial Robustness Toolbox)
